scheme_name: Tool Kit Grant for Traditional Handicrafts Experts
other_conditions: Applicant must be engaged in traditional craftwork or skilled work.
Preference is given to applicants with more than two girl children, differently abled persons, and those with over 10 years of experience.
benefits_summary: Provides up to ₹25,000 grant for tool kits and training, with training stipend up to ₹5,000 and a maximum training period of three months.
